translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Nenñaa pallu tsai dekipiñubaJosé wainmi.
José entsai' peesu punu uwanu, Egipto reichi binu kiikemula' bale ruku bain, naa reichi pan kiikemula' bale ruku bain yanu uudenguemu rukunu firu' dekiñu,
faraón ajaatyatu, juntsa pai bale rukulanu
peesu depumi, washna' keekeenamu suutadula' ama' yasha, matyu José bain punu peesu yasharen.
Tsenñu peesu pumulanu washna' keekeenamu suutadula' amaya Josénaa washke' keekeenanu uudenguemi entsa rukulanu. Tsenñu yala junga peesusha jayee wadepula.

Tsanaturen entsa pai rukula reichi binu kikare' taji' kumu bain, reichi pan kiikemu ruku bain, main main kipila mangueperen. Tsenmin main main yala' kipiñu naaju' tsaañuba vee vee aseetanguekaanu jumi.
Juntsa kepenene José yala' junga ji' keeñu yuj llaki jula.
Tsenñu José yalanu pake'meetu tsandimi: ¿Nenñu deeyu uma yuj llakindyañu' kajuru jula? timi.

Tsenñu yala pakatu: Lala uma naa-i kipi' bain mijanu tenñuba, munu kuinda ke' wandikutin tsa deetu deeyu, tila. Tsenñu José pakatu: ¿Mu bain naa-i dekipiñuba Dioschee aseetangue' panutsumi jutyuu? Tsaaya inu kuinda kikai naa-i dekipiyu, timi.
Tsenñu binu kikare' faraónnu taji' kuwa kuwakemu bale ruku naa-i kipi'ba Josénu entsandi kuinda kemi: Kipibi uva chuwa main katañu,
jei awamin pen pala vi' llullu kemin, ya' llullu jumula uva tyundyu tene tiyaimin jei lluve.
Tsaiñu, iya uva katu, chuyi' bejte' basunu pu' faraón' tyaapanu taji' kuwayu, timi.
Tsenñu José tsandimi: Ñu' kipiñuya entsandi aseetanguikarave: pen ali juushu juntsaya pen malu juve.
Pen malu insha faraón ñunu livee ke' manen mishu mangujte', ñu' kaspee taawasha kinsha manbunu tsuve, tsenmala ñu kaspele naakentsumuwa ju'ba faraónnu tsa manguentsunu tsuve.
Tsejtu ñunu demangalaañu miji', ñu junga ura' manbumiya inu mandengaka, tsejtu in mitya tsantsaya faraónnu pade inu peesu mangalaanutsu.
Iyaa hebreo chachilla' tusha tara' jamuyu, tsenñuren iya enu peesu viinuu firu' kindyun peesu depuve, timi.

Tsenñu faraónchi pan kiikemu bale ruku bain Josénu meenatu naa-i kipiñuba aseetangue' uraanuuya pañu' mitya, ya bain kuinda ketu entsandimi: I bain, kipibi pen kaa pishkalisha fibaba pan tene in mishpukasha chujti' tanayu.
Tsenñu kayu kai'sha llai'namu kaa pishkalishaya faraónchi pure' vee vee pingala pan juu depunuren, pishkula in mishbui'sha deja' pishkalisha pan pumunun fifidekive, timi.
Tsandiñu, José pakatu tsandimi: Ñu' kipiñuya entsandi aseetanguikarave: pen kaa pishkali pan juushu juntsaya pen malu juve.
Pen malusha faraón ñu' mishu daakakare', ñu' bulu cha'linu tu'pu' uikaanu juve. Tsenmala pishkulaa deja' ñu' alla finu detsuve, timi.

Tsenñu pen malu insha faraónchi ya' nakayanu malu machañu, fandangu kemi ya' taawasha kemu chachillaba. Tsangue' demikatu, faraón uudengue', naa binu kekare' taji' kuwa kuwakemu bale rukunu bain, naa pan kiikemu bale rukunu bain peesu demangalaanu eemi.
Tsejtu binu kikare' kuwa kuwakemu bale rukunuya ya' kaspee taawasha kiikensha manbumi. Tsenñu juntsa ruku ya kaspele naakentsumuwa ju'ba tsa manguentsumi.
Tsangueturen, pan kiikemu bale rukunuya chisha yangaakaakemi, matyu José naati aseetangue' pañuba juntsaimi.
Tsaaren, binu kikare' faraónnu kuwa kuwakemu bale rukuya pashiitu, Josénu mandengai'mi.
